narration: ハンターと消防署員ら、合わせて26人が捜索に加わります。
asset_type: キャラアニメーション
scene: 林道の集合場所に並ぶ捜索隊26人。前列にハンター（CHAR-05・CHAR-09）と消防署員、後列に大勢。

fences.text: (CHAR-05 再利用) [Generic group] Cute cartoon character design, thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, large expressive eyes, children's animation style. A search party of Japanese hunters and firefighters facing the viewer, front-row faces clearly visible. Front row, left to right: 1) (CHAR-05 再利用) a Japanese local hunter in his 60s with short grey hair and a grey stubble, an orange cap, a dark green field jacket under a blaze-orange safety vest, khaki trousers and brown boots, pointing forward, eyebrows driven down hard, mouth wide open shouting, sweat on his temple; 2) (CHAR-09 再利用) a Japanese young hunter in his 30s with short black hair, a dark green cap, a dark green field jacket under a blaze-orange safety vest, khaki trousers and brown boots, fists clenched, eyes wide and fierce, mouth open; 3) a Japanese firefighter in his 40s with a plain navy work uniform and a white helmet, stocky, eyebrows pulled together, jaw tight, sweat on his brow; 4) a Japanese firefighter in his 20s, tall and thin, plain navy work uniform and a white helmet, eyes wide and nervous, mouth open; 5) a Japanese hunter in his 50s, heavy-set, a brown cap and a brown jacket under a blaze-orange vest, grim frown, teeth gritted. NO TWO OF THEM SHARE A FACE, A HAIRSTYLE OR AN OUTFIT. No two of them are the same height. Behind them, partly hidden by the front row, only heads and shoulders show, drawn a little smaller: more hunters in orange vests and firefighters in white helmets, roughly twenty-six people in all. Do NOT draw only five people. No lettering, no badge, no logo, no emblem anywhere. Each figure has a very large head about one third of the total height, a short compact torso and short stubby arms and legs, roughly three heads tall.
